baseline.equivalence_test: The disabled arm and no-hook path must preserve hidden tensors exactly, and every hook handle must be removed after a call or exception.

core_invariants: Production selector, retrieval, selected IDs/order, context, prompt, decode policy, evaluator, labels, answers, and candidate path remain frozen.
Reader spans are gold-free pre-generation locators only; gold, answer, evaluator, split, post-generation output, and result feedback are forbidden.
The hook is installed by a context manager for one Generator call and removed in finally; no process-global hook or implicit discovery.
Exactly one transport arm is active per call; invalid rows use a disabled zero-anchor fallback without dropping or retrying the question.
Formal utility remains blocked pending separately authorized screen, preregistration, full-data run, and independent-executor replication.

invariants: Unchanged prompt serialization, token IDs, attention mask, offsets, and special-token mask are asserted; raw text is memory-only and never persisted.
Anchors use the Generator's own layer-30 prompt states; each row removes its own shared lexical mean before normalization.
Only the input pre-hook of model.model.layers[30] may be modified; padding positions and disabled rows remain unchanged.

plugins.insertion_point: Frozen DPR reader hypotheses are uniquely located inside selected passages, then mapped through the existing prompt serializer/tokenizer boundary with exact prompt and token preservation.
plugins.hypothesis: Frozen gold-free reader offsets can be mapped to existing Generator token indices without changing the prompt.
plugins.resource_estimate: One frozen DPR reader hypotheses call plus CPU-only character/token offset mapping; scores are discarded and never reach selection.

plugins.insertion_point: First layer-30 pre-forward call, before residual modification.
plugins.hypothesis: Layer-30 prompt states provide a native anchor space without external projection or span-text copying.
plugins.resource_estimate: One per-row mean and RMS normalization over already computed prompt states.

plugins.insertion_point: Same scoped layer-30 pre-hook, returning hidden_states unchanged.
plugins.hypothesis: Adapter plumbing has exact disabled-path parity with the frozen Generator.
plugins.resource_estimate: No tensor copy for an all-disabled batch; scoped hook only.

plugins.insertion_point: Layer-30 pre-hook; add one fixed normalized anchor at each row's final non-padding prompt token and each cached decode token.
plugins.hypothesis: Reader-localized native states can alter evidence use through downstream Transformer blocks, not a terminal logit bias.
plugins.resource_estimate: One scoped pre-hook and one per-row hidden-state update; batch/padding safe.

plugins.insertion_point: Identical layer-30 hook and answer-prefix positions with disjoint non-reader spans matching reader count and lengths.
plugins.hypothesis: A deterministic matched null isolates reader content from generic prompt geometry and shared residual structure.
plugins.resource_estimate: Same cost as the reader arm; no extra model loading.

composition.merge_rule: Provenance and capture precede one mutually exclusive transport arm; invalid rows are disabled per question and no arm is composed with another.
interaction_ablations: Reader versus matched non-reader at identical geometry, alpha, layer, decoding, and context.
Valid rows versus per-question disabled fallback under mixed left/right padding.
Each active arm versus final-linear-readout-plus-rescaling surrogate.

validation.baseline_equivalence: Disabled hook returns None and preserves hidden tensors exactly; all handles are removed after normal and exceptional exits.

reproducibility.dataset_identity: synthetic boundary fixture only; no task dataset, labels, answers, passages, predictions, or evaluator output
reproducibility.environment: Python 3.10+; torch is required only for hook tests; no model or corpus download

full_real_data_l2.formal_data_scope: Complete preregistered natural NQ-open population fixed before any formal run; no post-hoc eligibility or slice selection.
full_real_data_l2.data_exposure_policy: Git retains compact summaries at or below 1 MiB; larger raw result files use authenticated exchange and are represented by path, size, and SHA-256.
full_real_data_l2.l4_attribution_plan: After L2/L3 only, compare reader and matched-null transport with final-logit, finite-shot, and resource controls.

recovery_contract.discriminating_intermediate_measurement: Reader-minus-matched-null downstream answer-prefix attention redistribution and final-linear-readout-plus-rescaling R2 below 0.90.

limitations: The boundary and task adapter are implemented and validated only on synthetic token batches; no task data, retrieval, selector, evaluator, or production Generator mutation is included.

The task adapter reuses frozen DPR reader hypotheses and accepts only uniquely locatable, non-overlapping passage-local spans; rejected or unrepresentable rows become disabled rather than being tuned or retried.
Beam expansion and changing batch size are rejected by contract; use greedy fixed-batch generation or route the row to disabled fallback before hook installation.
Any real-data stage requires separate authorization and all-question accounting.
